observations.why: Present-progressive 'switching' frames an ongoing decision; named databases make it concrete; the migration is planned not yet settled, carrying irrealis.
Projected outcomes of the switch — performance and cost gains — are forward-looking, hypothetical, and stated as general categories rather than specific events.
Migration arrow denotes a planned transition between two named systems; concrete artifacts, present framing of an unsettled move.
Projected performance gain is a forward-looking, hypothetical outcome expressed as a general metric category.
A specific future quarter anchors a planned, not-yet-realized timeline — concrete temporal target with irrealis modality.
